title: Critique: the noninferential and timing conditions are ad hoc

statements.text: If consciousness is a relation between a higher-order and a first-order representation, the causal origin of the higher-order state should not matter, so ruling out inference and observation, and requiring the same time and mind, are stipulations that an ambitious theory should not need.

sources.quote: Further, the higher order theory (in its ambitious form) is ad hoc
